main_text.l: Tristes latebræ, claustraque montibus Obtecta, non nostræ minaces Insidias meditantur urbi. Sic tu Geneuam Cœlituum Pater Præsente semper Numine sospita Cunctisque seruatum periclis Protege Lurbinium precamur. Ducis superbi perge ferociam, Fastusque forti tundere brachio Ut urbe tuta te decoris Incolumes celebremus hymnis.

page.notes: Verse printed in italic type with long s; the ligatures and the initial capitals of the verse lines are as printed. The faint text in the right margin is show-through from the facing page and is omitted.
